_comment: SCHEMA.md rules shared by the Go store/TUI and the Python Plugin, as vectors. Both sides assert this file: internal/store/tests/conformance_test.go, internal/ui/conformance_internal_test.go and plugin/tests/test_conformance.py. Expected values follow SCHEMA.md, not either implementation; a side that does not meet a vector yet skips it through its test's known-drift table, keyed by audit finding. Each line is appended to base and must read as valid (or malformed) on both sides; enums, payPerYear and payFX must equal each side's tables. Change a rule here and on both sides together.

_follow_up: SCHEMA status_log -> Follow-up due. Each case builds a meta.yml from base, followed_up, next_step and status_log; now is the Owner's clock (its offset is the Owner's zone; Python also sets TZ to it). want.from is the day the count runs from and since what it is; due_on is from + days; days_past is today - due_on, null when the Application cannot be due (not Applied or Interviewing, or held by a next step on or after today). Go: internal/ui/followup.go + urgency.go; Python: meta.follow_up_status.

follow_up.name: applied and quiet past the period
due on the day the period ends
not yet due
a shorter follow_up_days
interviewing can be due
offer is never due
a lead is never due
a later follow-up restarts the count
a follow-up before a later move is history
same day: the Status change wins
followed_up that is not a date reads as unset
an undone move is ignored
an undo at exactly 15 minutes is still an undo
a move back after the undo window is a real move
date-only entries never read as an undo
an undone Applied leaves a Draft that is never due
a next step booked today holds it
a next step with a time later today holds it
a future next step holds it
a past next step no longer holds it
east of UTC: a timestamp counts on its local day
east of UTC: same local day, the move wins over l
west of UTC: a timestamp counts on its local day
east of UTC: same day in both zones
a date-only entry keeps its written day in any zone
east of UTC: a next step today holds it before UTC reaches today

_posting_age: SCHEMA search_rules -> whether a Lead's ad is expired. limit is the effective max_posting_age_days (the Source's own rules win, matched by name ignoring case), null when none; age_days is today - posted; expired is age_days >= limit; days_left is limit - age_days while not expired, else null; warn is the TUI's 'expires in N days' (not expired and days_left <= expiry_warning_days). Go: internal/ui/age.go + urgency.go (expired, days_left, warn); Python: rules.check_age (limit, age_days, expired).

posting_age.name: at the edge of the warning
a Source limit, a day under it
a Source limit, a day over it
another Source's limit does not apply
a Source limit longer than the global one
a Source limit with no global one
